description: Remove the email-format validation from validate_user_email

violation_scenario: validate_user_email('not-an-email') returns 'not-an-email' instead of raising InvalidEmailFormatError.
rationale: Deleting the two validation lines is the smallest plausible change that lets a malformed email through.
